therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: androgen signaling inhibition in castration-resistant prostate cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer previously treated with novel hormonal agents

results.dose_information: 600 mg BID orally on a continuous basis

context.investigator_commentary: Decision Board no further financial support after 3 years of follow-up as remaining patients in follow-up phase would not relevantly change the endpoints.
